pstack-verifier: PASS+NOTES @ 6ed70e4cadb56d5122f188b7f817a5306c38a0e0

Verified by DeepSeek (deepseek-flash), a different model family from the author, on a GitHub-hosted runner. It read the diff and text evidence only, never screenshots.

The diff adds a Claude command snapshot plus a ranked menu() that puts exact/prefix name matches above description matches and above skills, and the native-skills journey passes on both parent and head, so nothing regressed. However, no driven journey actually shows a Claude command in the slash menu, /clear ranking first for /cl, or a command being tapped into the composer, and no unit-test run appears in the recorded pipeline.

Journeys driven (parent is the app before this change, head is after):
- `native-skills.md` parent: passed, head: passed

Evidence:
- native-skills.md journey: parent passed and head passed with DRIVER EXIT 0 over the same 16 steps, so the existing skill parse, insert, model and effort flows are unchanged.
- native-receipts.txt on both sides contains only /review-native, /qa:verify-native, /model sonnet and /effort high, so no Claude command was ever selected or sent during the run.
- The step names (05-native-slash-list, 06-native-filtered, 07-native-inserted) are identical on parent and head, so the content change in the slash list is not visible in the text evidence.
- NativeSkills.menu in the diff ranks exact name (0), name prefix (1), name word-prefix (2), name contains (3) above description prefix (4) and subsequence (5), and breaks ties with commands before skills, which matches the claimed /cl -> /clear ordering.
- NativeSkillPicker in MultipromptApp.kt keeps the loading, error and 'No matching session skills' notes while showing commands next to session skills, and the selection callback is unchanged.
- The new unit test claudeCommandsRankClearFirstAndANameMatchBeatsADescription asserts the described order, but the recorded pipeline steps (build-apk, build-instrumentation, native-ui) contain no unit-test task, so its result is not evidenced.
- Several snapshot descriptions in NativeSkills.kt are visibly truncated mid-sentence (e.g. 'Set up Claude GitHub Actions for a', 'Order Claude Code stickers' entry style), a cosmetic wart not covered by any check.

Not covered:
- No journey typed /cl in a Claude chat and confirmed /clear is the first row.
- No journey tapped a Claude command row and confirmed the message box is filled (e.g. with /clear).
- No journey confirmed clear, compact, model, resume and context appear in the menu, or that a session skill still ranks correctly with the command list present.
- No evidence of the unit test actually passing, since no test task ran in the recorded pipeline.
- No evidence of how /resume behaves when sent, or that /model still opens the model picker when tapped, and no evidence on how the truncated command descriptions render on screen.

Run: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android/actions/runs/43843920094
